subject: Road to Decision: MAP draft + GDoc outline for GreenGrid evaluation
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@greengrid.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@greengrid.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2028-11-07 09:12 -0800
Subject: Road to Decision: MAP draft + GDoc outline for GreenGrid evaluation

Hi Emily — great to meet on the call earlier. As promised, I attached a lightweight MAP template that we use for pilots and trials and seeded a first-pass Google Doc outline for your team. The goal is a compact plan that covers technical validation, procurement checkpoints, and an acceptance milestone so you can close the internal decision window in ~6 weeks.

Quick notes in the draft: 
- Week 0: environment & access (credentials, network whitelist, initial dataset)
- Week 1–2: model proof-of-concept (latency + quality checks, 3 sample prompts)
- Week 3–4: scale test (batching, throughput, cost estimates)
- Week 5–6: acceptance & runbook handoff (SLOs, rollback plan)

Action for GreenGrid: could you share a preferred acceptance metric (e.g., top-1 rerank recall target, latency p95) and whether procurement needs an initial commercial term before technical validation? I included a short procurement checklist in the attached spreadsheet to speed review.

Links/attachments:
- MAP draft GDoc (edit access): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xG-MAP-draft-redwood-gg
- Attachments: MAP_Template_Redwood_v3.docx, WeekbyWeek_Glide.gslides, GreenGrid_requirements.xlsx (see procurement tab)

I'll keep the doc open to co-edit — if you prefer, we can run a 30-min coauthor session tomorrow to finalize owners and dates.

Thanks,

Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@greengrid.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@greengrid.com>, procurement@greengrid.com
Date: 2028-11-07 12:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Road to Decision: MAP draft + GDoc outline for GreenGrid evaluation

Thanks Camila — this looks helpful and a lot cleaner than what we usually do. A few notes from our side (summarized):

- Acceptance metric: aiming for 92% precision@5 for our search rerank use-case; p95 latency target < 250ms for 1k concurrent users.
- Procurement: we can start with an MSA addendum; procurement team expects a pricing stub for pilot (<$2k/week) before they greenlight infra access.
- Tech: Daniel says we can provide a 10k-record sample dataset and a staging VPC; he'll need the whitelist IPs and an integration checklist.

I've left comments on the GDoc for Week 1 and Week 3 tasks. Can Camila or your engineering buddy paste sample success criteria in Week 1 (quality tests) so our engineers can vet it?

Also — procurement@greengrid.com copied for visibility; they asked for a quick line item they can plug into the RFx.

Best,
Emily Zhao
Head of Product, GreenGrid
emily.zhao@greengrid.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@greengrid.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@greengrid.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2028-11-08 08:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Road to Decision: MAP draft + GDoc outline for GreenGrid evaluation

Appreciate the clarity, Emily — helpful requirements. I've updated the GDoc with concrete success criteria and filled the Week 1 quality test section with a short checklist you can copy into your validation plan:

- Dataset sanity checks & holdout split (owner: GreenGrid eng)
- Prompt suite (10 canonical prompts + 5 edge cases)
- Human eval: 50-sample randomized review, accept if >=92% precision@5
- Latency baseline: run single-node p95; target <250ms on staging VPC

Commercial note: Ben (cc'd) added a pilot pricing stub in the attached spreadsheet — it's intentionally lightweight to avoid procurement delays. Procurement line for RFx: "Pilot access to Redwood Inference hosted endpoint, up to 1 GPU-equivalent capacity, weekly billing, includes 1 integration support session."

Proposed next steps:
1) Coauthor session (30m) to lock owners and dates — how's 2028-11-09 10:00 PT for your team?
2) GreenGrid confirms acceptance metric and approves pilot stub for procurement by 2028-11-10
3) We enable staging access and share IP whitelist by 2028-11-13

If that timeline works, I'll mark owners in the MAP doc and export a one-page PDF for your procurement team.

—Camila
